youtube.title: Pearl Harbor: Radar Saw the Attack Coming 53 Minutes Early
youtube.description:
On the morning of 7 December 1941, the attack on Pearl Harbor had already been seen coming. A destroyer fired on a Japanese submarine at the harbor entrance more than an hour before. Two Army privates watched the incoming planes on radar 53 minutes early. Both warnings were reported. Neither sounded the alarm. This is the full file: where each warning went, and why the officer everyone blamed was cleared.

1:34 The submarine
